hesapSil.misafirBody: A guest account has no permanent data to delete. Complete your account first, or sign out.
hesapSil.sonOnayMesaj: Your account will be closed. Profile, content, and sessions will be cleared. This cannot be undone.
hesapSil.silindiMesaj: Your account was closed. Your profile shows as “Account deleted”. You can create a new account with Apple or email.
hesapSil.uyariKalici: This permanently closes your account. Your profile shows as “Account deleted”; your statuses, rooms, and agency are removed. If you are in a voice room, you leave automatically. Signing in again with Apple opens a new empty account; the old one cannot be restored.
hesapSil.uyariIade: In case of store refunds, chargebacks, or fake receipts, open exchange agreements are cancelled, the balance is reclaimed, and the account may be suspended / closed. Exchange is disabled for accounts with a refund history.
hesapSil.sebepKullanmiyorum: I no longer use the app
hesapSil.madde1: Profile becomes “Deleted account”; name, photo, bio, phone, and birth date are erased
hesapSil.madde2: Your status posts and comments are hidden
hesapSil.madde3: Your room / live stream comments are removed
hesapSil.madde4: Open rooms and streams are closed; sessions end
hesapSil.madde5: Push notifications and your bank details are cleared
hesapSil.madde6: If possible, the login identity is deleted too (Apple/Google requirement)
hesapSil.madde7: Open exchange agreements may be cancelled; refund/chargeback risk is grounds for account closure
